patches.title: Skip Initial Look
patches.principle: Start by moving to a countertop rather than using the look command to begin object search immediately.
patches.when_to_apply: At the start of any task when the environment is first entered.

patches.title: Avoid Shelves for Cleaning
patches.principle: During object search for cleaning tasks, skip shelves and retain focus on countertops, dining tables, and the sink.
patches.when_to_apply: When the task involves cleaning and the target object is not immediately visible.
